adapters.label: Dialogue Brain
adapters.description: Handles normal Commander dialogue, reasoning, explanations, and safe non-tool answers.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return a safe explanation that the dialogue brain could not complete and suggest a more specific question.

adapters.label: Live Web Research Adapter
adapters.description: Retrieves current public information and source trails for unstable facts.
adapters.failure_fallback: State that live verification failed and provide the safest known answer without pretending it is current.

adapters.label: Kingsmen Knowledge Adapter
adapters.description: Searches approved Kingsmen doctrine, architecture, pricing, workflow, and build knowledge.
adapters.failure_fallback: State that Kingsmen knowledge lookup failed and answer only from visible context.

adapters.label: GitHub Repo Inspection Adapter
adapters.description: Inspects approved GitHub repository files, issues, commits, and build evidence.
adapters.failure_fallback: State that repo inspection failed and do not guess file or issue state.

adapters.label: System Health Adapter
adapters.description: Checks approved health endpoints and returns safe system status summaries.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return health-check failure and next safe diagnostic step.

adapters.label: Validation Adapter
adapters.description: Runs or prepares approved validators and returns proof, failures, and repair direction.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return validator failure and repair path without claiming phase completion.

adapters.label: Build Adapter
adapters.description: Runs approved build checks and summarizes success, failure, and repair path.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return build failure and repair path; do not modify code inside build command.

adapters.label: PostgreSQL Read Model Adapter
adapters.description: Reads only approved operational summaries and never raw private rows.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return database summary failure and recommend safe read-model repair.

adapters.label: Playwright Scout Adapter
adapters.description: Scouts approved pages for reachability, blockers, screenshots, and manual fallback evidence.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return blocker/failure evidence and recommend manual fallback; do not bypass blockers.

adapters.label: Report Generation Adapter
adapters.description: Generates Founder-facing reports, summaries, digests, and reviewable plans.
adapters.failure_fallback: Generate a partial digest and mark missing evidence clearly.

adapters.label: Evidence Pack Adapter
adapters.description: Generates reviewable evidence packs from approved evidence trails.
adapters.failure_fallback: Return partial evidence pack and list missing proof.

adapters.label: Approval Flow Adapter
adapters.description: Creates Commander approval requests for risky commands.
adapters.failure_fallback: If approval cannot be created, keep the action blocked.

adapters.label: Blocked Adapter
adapters.description: Handles explicitly blocked commands by refusing the action and redirecting to a safe Kingsmen workflow.
adapters.failure_fallback: Keep command blocked and state safe alternative.
adapters.blocked_reason: Blocked commands cannot be routed to active operational tools.
